jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React / Node.js) AI-First
jobs.description:
We are looking for Senior Full\-Stack Developer (React / Node.js) AI\-First. You will own features end\-to\-end: React on the front\-end, Node.js on the back\-end, deployed with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS. Small team, hands\-on senior role — you ship, you deploy, you support what you build.


The team develops AI\-first. AI coding tools are the default way work gets done, not an experiment. On the front\-end in particular, we expect you to generate most of the UI with AI — screens, components, state, tests — and spend your time on architecture, review and product quality, not on hand\-typing JSX. We expect you to already work this way.

**What you will do:**

* Build and ship full\-stack features: React front\-end \+ Node.js services and APIs
* Build the front\-end AI\-first: turn designs, specs or screenshots into working React screens using AI coding agents; generate components, forms, tables, state logic and tests; then review, harden and integrate
* Set up and maintain the AI workflow for front\-end work: project rules/context files, component conventions, design\-system references and prompt patterns so AI output matches the codebase
* Containerize services with Docker, deploy and operate them on Kubernetes and AWS
* Maintain CI/CD, monitoring and logging for what you own
* Review code (human\- and AI\-written) and work directly with the product and management team

  

Requirements:  

  

**Must have:**

* 5\+ years of professional software development
* True full\-stack: 3\+ years where you regularly delivered both the React front\-end and the Node.js back\-end of the same features yourself, in production. This role requires equal depth on both sides; profiles weighted to one side only will not fit.
* Strong React: hooks, state management, performance, TypeScript
* Strong Node.js: API design, async patterns, auth, testing
* Hands\-on production experience with Kubernetes, Docker and AWS
* AI\-first front\-end development, proven in production:
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar) to build React UI end\-to\-end
* Can show real examples of screens or features built mostly with AI and explain what was kept, what was rewritten and why
* Knows how to give the agent the right context (design files, component library, existing patterns, API contracts) to get code that fits the codebase, not generic output
* Knows where AI breaks on front\-end work — state bugs, accessibility, performance, inconsistent styling — and how to catch it
* AI\-first across the stack: uses AI for back\-end code, tests, refactoring, debugging and reviews as well; can explain how prompts, context and agent workflows are structured, and how output is verified
* Git, CI/CD, automated testing as a habit
* **Independent, communicates clearly, owns a feature from idea to production**

**Huge bonus:**

* **React Native** — shipped mobile apps to App Store / Google Play (OTOFusion has a React Native mobile app)
* Experience with AI design\-to\-code tools (Figma\-to\-code, v0, Lovable, Bolt or similar) as part of a real delivery flow

jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help define an agentic\-first approach to software development. This person designs agentic workflows using Java, Spring Boot, React, and AI orchestration patterns, turning successful experiments into production systems. Strong judgment around security, reliability, and auditability matters for enterprise customers.

**What you will do**

* Design and build agentic workflows that coordinate tools, services, data, and human approvals.
* Develop reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, context management, memory, and multi\-agent collaboration.
* Use agentic coding tools throughout the development lifecycle, including planning, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation.
* Integrate agents into software development, testing, deployment, support, and operational workflows.
* Establish standards for agent evaluation, observability, reliability, security, and governance.
* Prototype new agentic capabilities and turn successful experiments into production systems.
* Build complete, usable products—not just demonstrations or isolated model integrations.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and product delivery through agentic development.
* Mentor engineers and help shape an agentic\-first technical strategy across the organization.
* Collaborate with product and engineering leaders to connect agentic capabilities to meaningful outcomes.
* Design agentic applications around real user needs, including intuitive experiences, reliable workflows, permissions, audit trails, and meaningful error handling.
* Move agentic solutions from prototype to production by addressing performance, scalability, security, monitoring, evaluation, cost, and ongoing maintenance.

**Must haves**

* **5\+ years of experience** in a software product development environment.
* Strong proficiency with **Java and Spring Boot**.
* Strong proficiency with **JavaScript and React**.
* Strong proficiency with **Relational Databases**.

jobs.title: Senior, AI Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on \[1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  

You'll join our engineering experts within the \[2] AI, Insights \& Solutions (AIS) team . This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise and business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data\-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human\-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage. Our collaborative and supportive environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
  
  

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  

The Senior AI Engineer will build and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. You will contribute across the development lifecycle \-\- from prototyping through to production deployment \-\- working closely with engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role focused on delivering high\-quality technical output and deepening your expertise across the AI Engineering skillset.
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
* Build and deploy end\-to\-end generative AI systems, including agentic workflows and production\-grade AI applications
* Build and iterate on multi\-component AI pipelines, including:
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine\-tuning and parameter\-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build agentic systems with sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud\-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support GenAIOps processes including automated testing, regression evaluation, and latency monitoring
* Apply performance, safety, and responsible AI principles across system design, including guardrails, fallbacks, and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) workflows
* Build evaluation frameworks covering hallucination rate, factual consistency, relevance, latency, throughput, and cost
* Collaborate effectively with product, engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams
* Communicate technical findings clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders


MUST HAVE
  
* 2\-4\+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands\-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end\-to\-end, from prototyping through production
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills
* Working knowledge of evaluation design and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with
* RAG architectures (vector\-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph\-based approaches is a plus)
* Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management)
* AI\-Specific Tools \& Frameworks \- Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model \+ API ecosystems
* Strong foundation in software engineering, system design, and production\-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical collaborators
* Comfort operating in high\-ambiguity, collaborative environments
* Experience in client\-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus


WORKING MODEL \& TRAVEL
  
* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

2\. https://www.bain.com/careers/work\-with\-us/integrated\-teams/ai\-insights\-solutions\-ais/

jobs.description:
**About Atria:**


The Atria Health Institute is a membership\-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision\-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.


Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real\-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team\-wide dedication to excellence.  

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026\.


Atria Health is seeking a Senior Software Engineer for our DevOps team to help design, build, and operate the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that the rest of engineering relies on every day.


This is an individual contributor role focused on:

* Owning infrastructure, CI/CD, and automation initiatives end to end; from design through rollout, adoption, and iteration
* Setting the patterns and standards that keep our systems reliable, observable, and secure as we scale
* Reducing operational toil and raising the bar on developer productivity across engineering


You'll partner with the Tech Lead and other DevOps engineers to shape our infrastructure\-as\-code, build and release process, and monitoring and security posture — and you'll help define the standards others build on. You'll work closely with the Platform, Data Engineering, and domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery) to anticipate their needs and make their path to production smoother. You'll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve, while working to accelerate the work of our client teams.

**Infrastructure \& Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, and help define the patterns and standards the team builds on.
* Own and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to make deployments fast, safe, and repeatable.
* Identify and eliminate sources of operational toil, building automation and tooling that scales across engineering.

**Reliability \& Observability**

* Establish meaningful monitoring, dashboards, and alerting in Datadog, and drive down alert noise across the team's systems.
* Lead incident response within the on\-call rotation, and drive postmortems and follow\-ups that improve uptime for our applications.
* Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for our core infrastructure and build systems, and hold the team to them.

**Developer Enablement**

* Partner with product engineering teams on deployment pipelines, environment issues, and build troubleshooting, and proactively remove recurring friction.
* Own preview and staging environments, including reliable data sync, masking, and cleanup routines so teams can test against realistic data.
* Improve developer experience through better tooling, clear runbooks, and documentation.

**Quality \& Collaboration**

* Write well\-tested, well\-reviewed infrastructure code, and lead design reviews and RFCs with a pragmatic, operations\-focused perspective.
* Design systems and changes to meet the team's goals, weighing tradeoffs across reliability, performance, and security.
* Give thoughtful code reviews and mentor other engineers through pairing, knowledge sharing, and documentation.

**Tech Stack**

* Languages: TypeScript, Python, Bash
* Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, Cloudflare
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions
* Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
* Observability \& Incident Management: Datadog, Sentry, Rootly
* Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third\-party healthcare APIs

  

**Requirements** **Core Experience**

* \~5\+ years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or backend engineering in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating infrastructure in at least one cloud provider (ideally Google Cloud Platform).
* Track record of owning and shipping automation, pipelines, or infrastructure that made a team measurably more productive or reliable.
* An enthusiasm for developer productivity and making our teams as impactful as possible.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (ideally Terraform) and building CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions).
* Proficient software engineering ability, and strong command of Linux.
* Strong instincts for monitoring and observability, and confident debugging across logs, traces, and metrics.
* Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and containerized workloads.
* Strong grounding in reliability, performance, and security fundamentals, with the judgment to make sound tradeoffs.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2, etc.).
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Exposure to leading incident response, on\-call, and postmortem practices.
* Experience with database migrations or managing multiple environments at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility- Romania(Remote)
jobs.description:
**Location**

  


The senior Full\-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full\-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.


**Who We Are**  

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud\-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state \- from planning to production.  

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.  

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.


**The Opportunity**  

AI is the fastest\-growing line on our customers' cloud bills \- and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.  

We're hiring a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer into our R\&D team to own this product end\-to\-end \- from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.  

You'll work AI\-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow \- not as an occasional autocomplete \- and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.


**Responsibilities**

* Owning features end\-to\-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome \- reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec.
* Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works \- token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives \- and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision.
* Working AI\-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work \- exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
* Full\-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious \- clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on.
* API\-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.


Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard\-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn.  

  

**Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi\-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end\-to\-end in production
* Strong Go for backend services \- APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them
* Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented
* Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface
* Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery
* Product\-oriented thinking \- you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built
* AI\-augmented working style \- you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short
* Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-moving market \- you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Self\-organized, goal\-oriented and self\-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious  

  

**Bonus Points**


* Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus.
* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far


**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.  

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.  

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.  

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.  

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.



Full\-time employee benefits include:


* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT** unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal\-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer — AI Products & Customer Implementations
jobs.description:
**About the role**
==================


Helpware's AI Platform team builds a portfolio of AI\-native products for customer support and business operations, all running on a shared multi\-tenant platform. The team also implements these products for individual clients with custom configurations, integrations, and SLAs.


We're looking for **two Senior QA Engineers** to own quality end\-to\-end — from pre\-release testing of the products themselves to validating each customer's live implementation. The two hires will share this work across the portfolio, with each expected to flex between product testing and customer\-facing implementation QA as priorities shift.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Own test strategy for one or more products in the AI portfolio, from requirements review through release sign\-off.
* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites covering **API, UI, integration, and regression testing**, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Test **multi\-tenant platform behavior**, including RBAC, tenant isolation, data access, and integrations with CRM, ticketing, telephony, and other third\-party systems.
* Validate AI\-agent behavior against functional requirements, including conversation flows, workflow automation, scoring and coaching logic, and structured\-data extraction.
* Lead QA for customer implementations by validating client\-specific configurations, connectors, knowledge bases, scoring rubrics, and workflow rules against requirements before go\-live.
* Design and execute **UAT plans** together with client stakeholders and internal delivery and Customer Success teams.
* Perform exploratory and scenario\-based testing against real customer workflows and monitor early\-production behavior after launch.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, implementation defects, and product\-level bugs, and ensure the right teams address them.
* Triage, document, and track defects; work closely with engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes.
* Maintain test plans, implementation checklists, and QA playbooks that can scale across a growing product portfolio and client base.
* Turn recurring implementation issues into automated regression coverage and continuously improve overall QA processes.
* Report on release readiness, product quality, and implementation risks to Product, Engineering, Delivery, and client\-facing teams.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* **5\+ years of experience in software QA**, including both product\-level testing and customer\-facing implementation or UAT activities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **test automation**, using tools such as **Playwright, Cypress, Selenium**, or similar.
* Solid experience with **API testing** using **Postman, REST\-assured**, or comparable tools.
* Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, with the ability to create meaningful test scenarios from business and client requirements.
* Experience testing **multi\-tenant and role\-based access systems**, including data isolation and configuration\-driven deployments.
* Ability to read and understand **API and database schemas** and work with engineers on root\-cause analysis.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into development and release processes.
* Comfortable working directly with external stakeholders during UAT and implementation validation.
* Strong understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, and release readiness.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for both technical and client\-facing audiences.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience testing **AI/LLM\-powered products**, including accuracy evaluation, hallucination checks, prompt regression, RAG quality, or AI output validation.
* Experience in **customer support, contact center, or BPO technology**, including call QA, workforce management, agent\-assist, or support automation platforms.
* Familiarity with **AWS\-based environments** and cloud\-based application testing.
* Experience with observability, logging, tracing, or monitoring tools used for production troubleshooting.
* Exposure to testing in **compliance\-sensitive environments**, such as SOC 2, HIPAA, or PCI\-DSS.
* Experience testing integrations with platforms such as **Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom**, telephony systems, or other customer\-support technologies.

jobs.description:
Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back


We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process For everyone, whatever their background or balance.


The proof: profitable, fast\-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.


We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.


Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast


**Meet the Team**
-----------------


Here at Cleo, we have \~200 Engineers organised into Pillars Our stack spans a Ruby on Rails monolith, a single React Native (TypeScript) app frontend, Python for machine learning services, and PostgreSQL, all hosted on AWS and shipped through Kubernetes \- backend goes out multiple times a week, app releases to Google and Apple at least weekly. To thrive here, our engineers proactively use our Engineering Principles to guide daily decisions, take ownership of problems beyond their own squad to drive broader impact, and actively drive their own learning, development and growth.

**About the Role**
------------------


We’re looking for a brilliant Frontend React or React Native Engineer with an eye for UI/UX design to join us on our mission to fight for the world's financial health. You’ll be joining a team of adaptable, creative and product\-focused engineers who ship working software. We understand our customers, we understand their pain, and we are passionate about helping them.


Key responsibilities include:

* Working on our React Native application, building out amazing experiences for our users which bring financial health to life in the unique Cleo tone of voice.
* Writing automated tests alongside your code to give us the confidence to ship it
* Using AB\-Tests, feature flags and other tools that let us iterate quickly
* Using data to dig into user journeys, detecting problems and helping to optimise the Cleo experience
* Being part of the rota for our weekly app releases to the Apple and Google app stores
* Getting involved in cross\-cutting concerns that lift our entire engineering effort with the rest of the frontend chapter
* Taking part in shaping all the work your squad does, not just the technical parts. Delivery is a team sport, and we encourage everyone at Cleo to share their ideas, so you can expect to be involved in product ideation sessions, user research calls, design reviews, retrospectives, ways of working sessions, product demos, OKR reviews.

  

Whichever squad and part of the business you land in, you will be shipping changes multiple times a week to our hundreds of thousands of active users and seeing your work having a material impact on the financial health of those most in need.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


You are passionate about making a positive difference in society by improving the financial health of our users. You align with our company values and engineering principles, which drive our ways of working and software delivery.


For this frontend focused role, we also have some specific asks:

* We’re looking for someone with strong industry experience of using React Native / React with TypeScript for a minimum of 5\+ years.
* As your work will primarily involve working on features for our mobile apps, we’d either like to see some proven experience in this area or a genuine passion for moving into the mobile app space.

**What we offer**
-----------------


We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, mental health support, a paid one\-month sabbatical after four years, a learning and development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location\-specific leave entitlements.  

  

For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub


**What Matters**
----------------


Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team \- and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their metris.


We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.


We may use AI\-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

Key Relationships, Stakeholders & Interfaces Enterprise Architecture / Solution Architects Integration CoE / Platform Team Times Globais de Tecnologia e Integração Parceiros estratégicos SAP e consultorias especializadas Áreas de infraestrutura, segurança e operações Stakeholders de programas de transformação digital e modernização SAP Conhecimento e Competências Técnicas Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Cursos/Conhecimentos Específicos Arquitetura de sistemas Segurança da informação Conceitos de Sistemas de Gestão Integrados Banco de dados e infraestrutura Governança TI (Cobit/Itil) Soluções de Automação Transformação digital Estratégia dos negócios Idiomas Inglês e Espanhol Avançados Educação/Experiência 5 a 10 anos de experiência Na Bunge, nosso objetivo é conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustível essenciais para o mundo. A Bunge tem sede registrada em Genebra, Suíça, e sua sede corporativa está localizada em St. Louis, Missouri, EUA. Saiba mais em bunge.com.br. Diariamente, nossos profissionais incorporam os valores que são a essência da Bunge: SOMOS UM SÓ TIME– Colaborativo, respeitoso e inclusivo LIDERAMOS O CAMINHO – Somos ágeis, Empoderados e inovadores FAZEMOS O QUE É CERTO – Com segurança, de forma sustentável e com integridade Reconhecemos que nosso sucesso depende da variedade de perspectivas que cada um de nossos colaboradores agrega à Bunge. jobs.title: Software Architect / Tech Lead
jobs.description:
**Junte\-se à Skopia Digital: Code o futuro, impacte milhões!**
===============================================================



Na Skopia Digital, tecnologia é sinônimo de ***transformação***. Somos a fusão da EclipsWorks e e da Nscreen, duas forças que uniram expertise em cloud AWS, transformação digital e inovação para criar soluções que simplificam negócios e mudam vidas. Em menos de dois anos, fomos eleitos pela EXAME a 2ª empresa que mais cresceu no Brasil em 2023, com mais de 100 tech lovers e clientes como Renault, Rede Dor, Claro e Sólides.



Nosso propósito? **Construir produtos e serviços que impactem positivamente milhões de brasileiros**. Seja migrando sistemas para a nuvem, arquitetando soluções escaláveis ou desenvolvendo IA generativa, nosso foco é entregar resultados reais. E isso é só o começo.


### **Como será seu dia a dia:**



Como **Software Architect / Tech Lead**, você atuará de forma estratégica e hands\-on, liderando tecnicamente o time e definindo arquiteturas escaláveis e resilientes.


* Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de **microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos**.
* Conduzir decisões arquiteturais, design reviews e code reviews.
* Liderar tecnicamente o time, apoiando desenvolvimento, mentoria e entregas.
* Atuar na interface entre **engenharia, produto e negócio**.
* Desenvolver e revisar soluções em **TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS)** e Python.
* Trabalhar com **REST, gRPC, mensageria (Kafka/RabbitMQ)** e bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
* Atuar com **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e cloud (GCP/AWS)**.
* Implementar **observabilidade, performance, resiliência e otimização de custos**.
* Projetar soluções com **IA/LLMs**, incluindo RAG, agentes, tool calling, avaliação de outputs e controle de custos.

### **Requisitos e qualificações:**


* **8\+ anos** de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
* **3\+ anos** em arquitetura e/ou liderança técnica.
* Domínio de **TypeScript/Node.js** e experiência com Python.
* Experiência comprovada com **microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos em produção**.
* Experiência com **mensageria e gRPC**.
* Vivência sólida em **GCP e/ou AWS**.
* Conhecimento de **Docker e Kubernetes**.
* Experiência com **observabilidade** (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog ou similares).
* Experiência prática com **LLMs aplicados a produtos**.
* Boa comunicação técnica e capacidade de interação com stakeholders não técnicos.

### **Não é imprescindível, mas valorizamos:**


* Pós\-graduação/MBA em tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
* Experiência em **consultoria e múltiplos clientes**.
* Inglês técnico.
* Conhecimento de **React, Next.js ou Angular**.
* Experiência com **Terraform/Pulumi**.
* Vivência em ambientes regulados, fiscais ou financeiros.
* Participação em comunidades, palestras ou projetos open source.

### **Como é trabalhar na Skopia?**



Aqui, você vai encontrar um ambiente onde Resultado, Criatividade, Pragmatismo, Comprometimento, Autoridade e Performance guiam o dia a dia. Somos parceiros Advanced AWS, o que significa que você terá acesso a projetos de ponta e apoio para tirar certificações AWS que vão alavancar sua carreira. Nossos rituais, como all\-hands para alinhar o time, sessões de feedback para crescer juntos e happy hours virtuais para descontrair, criam uma vibe colaborativa e dinâmica.


* Projetos que desafiam: Trabalhe com cloud journey, arquitetura, desenvolvimento e IA generativa para clientes de peso, resolvendo problemas complexos.
* Crescimento sem limites: Somos uma empresa em alta velocidade, com espaço para você liderar, inovar e se desenvolver.
* Cultura tech de verdade: Aqui, você pode ser sênior, mas nunca para de aprender. Trocamos ideias, testamos soluções e celebramos vitórias juntos.
* Benefícios que importam: Plano de saúde Bradesco, TotalPass, Programa de Certificação AWS, férias remuneradas (30 dias) e um ambiente que valoriza equilíbrio e respeito.
* Contrato PJ e Atuação remota.

**Quem procuramos?**
--------------------



Queremos talentos apaixonados por inovação, que curtam desafios e queiram deixar sua marca em projetos de impacto. Se você manja de tecnologia, pensa fora da caixa e gosta de trabalhar em um time que joga junto, a Skopia é o seu lugar.


**Pronto(a) para transformar o futuro com a gente?**
----------------------------------------------------



Confira nossas vagas, conheça nossos projetos e venha fazer parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo a transformação digital no Brasil. Bora codar o próximo grande impacto?

A nossa história começou em 1956, em Curitiba, e, desde então, crescemos junto com as famílias brasileiras. jobs.title: Analista de Testes Sênior | Remoto
jobs.description:
Com o crescimento da complexidade dos nossos produtos e a necessidade de acelerar ciclos de entrega com qualidade, abrimos uma posição para QA SR com foco em práticas modernas de qualidade. A pessoa será responsável pela qualidade na squad, atuando de forma estratégica na prevenção de defeitos, automação de testes e adoção de inteligência artificial no processo de QA.


**Responsabilidades e Atribuições**


* Liderar a implementação da cultura **Shift Left**, integrando qualidade desde as fases iniciais de discovery e refinamento, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando a confiabilidade das entregas
* Projetar, desenvolver e manter suítes de testes automatizados utilizando **Playwright**, cobrindo fluxos críticos de ponta a ponta (E2E), testes de regressão e testes de componentes
* Aplicar e promover o uso de **IA** no processo de QA, incluindo geração automatizada de casos de teste, análise de cobertura e identificação de padrões de falha com auxílio de ferramentas de AI
* Atuar como referência técnica em qualidade para as squads, participando de cerimônias ágeis, revisões de código e definição de critérios de aceite
* Definir e monitorar métricas de qualidade (taxa de defeitos, cobertura de testes, flakiness rate) integradas a pipelines de CI/CD


**Requisitos e Qualificações**


* Experiência sólida com **Playwright** para automação de testes E2E e de regressão
* Vivência prática com **Shift Left Testing**, atuando junto a times de produto e engenharia desde as etapas de planejamento
* Domínio de práticas de CI/CD com integração de testes automatizados (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps ou similares)
* Experiência com linguagens de programação para automação, como **TypeScript ou JavaScript**


**Diferenciais**


* Experiência com uso de **IA generativa** aplicada a QA (geração de casos de teste, análise de logs, cobertura inteligente)
* Conhecimento em **testes de performance e segurança** (ex.: k6, OWASP ZAP)
* Familiaridade com métricas DORA e como qualidade impacta indicadores como *Change Failure Rate* e *Lead Time for Change*
* Certificações em qualidade de software (ISTQB, CTAL) ou experiência liderando comunidades de prática em QA
